ipc_sections.title: Punishment for murder
ipc_sections.description: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death, or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.
examples: Causing death with the knowledge that it would likely result in death

ipc_sections.title: Punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder
ipc_sections.description: Whoever commits culpable homicide not amounting to murder shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Imprisonment for life or up to 10 years
examples: Death caused by rash or negligent act

ipc_sections.title: Punishment for theft
ipc_sections.description: Whoever commits theft shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.
ipc_sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both

ipc_sections.title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
ipc_sections.description: Whoever cheats and thereby dishonestly induces the person deceived to deliver any property to any person, or to make, alter or destroy the whole or any part of a valuable security, or anything which is signed or sealed, and which is capable of being converted into a valuable security, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

ipc_sections.title: Punishment for voluntarily causing hurt
ipc_sections.description: Whoever, except in the case provided for by section 334, voluntarily causes hurt, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees, or with both.
ipc_sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine up to Rs. 1000, or both

ipc_sections.title: Punishment for criminal intimidation
ipc_sections.description: Whoever commits criminal intimidation shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine, or with both.
ipc_sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both
examples: Warning of consequences to force action

ipc_sections.title: Assault or criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty
ipc_sections.description: Whoever assaults or uses criminal force to any woman, intending to outrage or knowing it to be likely that he will outrage her modesty, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which shall not be less than one year but which may extend to five years, and shall also be liable to fine.

ipc_sections.title: Punishment for kidnapping
ipc_sections.description: Whoever kidnaps any person from India or from lawful guardianship, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine
